declaration.intent: Calculate retained numeric amount totals by normalized region and calendar quarter, preserving duplicate records.

args.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(region),''),'UNKNOWN') AS region, 'Q' || CAST(((CAST(SUBSTR(service_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)-1)/3)+1 AS INTEGER) AS quarter, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS total FROM data WHERE amount NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND amount GLOB '*[0-9]*' GROUP BY region, quarter ORDER BY region, quarter
